idle: Hey, Skates! Yeah, you. That's your name now.
Broomball is hockey for people with jobs.
good_ice: Ice is grippy! Somebody tell Earl he did good. Don't tell him I said it.
bad_ice: This ice ate a sneaker. I want it back.
wet_ice: WHO FLOODED? Earl. It was Earl. It's always Earl.
Wet ice before broomball is a crime in three provinces.
cold: Cold? I'm in shorts. Grow up.
hungry: Fries! For the goalie! Goalies eat first!
long_line: Move it along, folks, the goalie's starving!
bored: Somebody chirp me. I'm getting rusty.
goal: THAT'S A GOAL! Not on me, obviously.
greet_owner: Boss! Big Boss! How's the empire?
There's the landlord! Is my flood on time?
leaving_happy: Good night! Nobody curled! Nobody curled at all!
leaving_angry: The Golden Boot's staying on my porch. Forever.

broomball: It is NOT curling with a ball!
special: Carnival night! Where's my Golden Boot?

first.say: You're the owner? Rhonda Pelkey. Harlow Falls Broomball Club, in goal. I name everybody in the first minute. Give me something to work with.

options.text: Broomball? Isn't that curling with a ball?
I'm the one who decides when the flood happens.

first_curling.say: Oh, you did NOT. Okay. Your name is Curling now. That's on you. That's permanent. Well, almost permanent.

first_flood.say: Ohhh. Then you're Big Boss. And you and me are going to have a lot of talks about Wednesday nights.

first_nice.say: Polite! Okay. You're Manners. Don't worry, it'll change. Everyone gets a better one eventually.

curling_greet.say: Well if it isn't Curling. Still think it's curling with a ball?

options.text: I take it back. Broomball is real.

say: Game night! Shorts on, sneakers taped, crease defended. Hi, Boss.
Hold on, hold on. (She blocks a ball with her face.) OKAY. Hi.
What's up? Make it fast, I've got a crease to defend.

options.text: Tell me about the Golden Boot.
What's the ice like for you?

job.say: Hydro dispatch. Storm comes in, forty trucks, ten thousand people with no power, and me, calm as a lake. Then I go stand in front of a ball at eighty kilometres an hour. It's relaxing.

events.say: Sneakers, brooms, a ball and no mercy. No skates, no excuses. And the Winter Carnival final, where we play for the Golden Boot. Biggest night of the year. Bigger than Christmas.

boot.say: A rubber boot. Painted gold. The Carnival trophy since forever, and it lives on my porch because nobody gave it a better home. The mailman salutes it.

options.text: Maybe it should live here someday.

gossip.say: Kev Szabo runs the club and has never forgiven anyone for saying 'curling'. He's my hero. Don't tell him. Dwayne Kuzyk plays like a shopping cart with one bad wheel. Love him. And Earl. Me and Earl have a thing.

gossip_earl.say: Every Wednesday he floods right before broomball and every Wednesday I tell him. He calls me 'the broom lady'. I call him 'the wet man'. It's healthy.

rink.say: Ice is {ice_word}. A late flood eats sneakers. The corners catch the brooms. And the dressing room smells like a hockey bag had a hockey bag.

rink_better.say: Grippy ice, no flood before we play, corners edged. Big Boss, I could kiss you. I won't. But I could.
